info.name: 3D Model Viewer Next
info.summary: Pure client-side 3D CAD & Mesh model viewer with native RSDOCX, STEP, STL and PLY support
info.description: Ultra-fast, minimal 3D CAD & Mesh viewer for Nextcloud. - Supported CAD formats: STEP, STP, IGES, IGS, SpaceClaim / DesignSpark Mechanical (RSDOC, RSDOCX), Parasolid (X_B, X_T) - Supported Mesh formats: STL, PLY, OBJ, 3MF, glTF, GLB - Native SpaceClaim thumbnail extraction in Nextcloud file manager (fast 2ms preview) - Orthographic CAD projection, flat studio lighting, pure authentic colors without distortion - Client-side WebAssembly & Web Worker acceleration with zero server GPU overhead
info.author: KikuchiMakoto
